gallery.title: File:Christian X.jpg
gallery.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Doug Wilson~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).
gallery.description:
King Christian X riding through Copenhagen on his 70th birthday, 26 September 1940. The picture was taken during the German occupation of Denmark.

Source: I, Peter the Great, proclaim that I am the colorizer of this photograph and am in possession of a complete set of working files that prove my proclamation. I hereby release all 306 x 458 or smaller versions to the public domain. The original photograph that I degrained and colorized was a public domain photo taken from C. Næsh Hendriksen: Den danske Kamp i Billeder og Ord, Odense: Bogforlaget Dana, 1945, p. 176. As per Danish law, all photos not considered to be works of art, become public domain after 50 years.
categories: Children of Denmark in World War II
Occupation of Denmark by Nazi Germany
Portrait photographs of Christian X of Denmark

gallery.title: File:Københavns byvåben 1894.png
gallery.artist: Unknown. The copyist's signature is intelligible, and his name is not indicated in the corresponding article. Illustration first published in the book Kjøbenhavn by Carl Bruun (1846-99). Based on the date of publication, I believe that this person must have died more than 70 years ago.
gallery.description: Coat of arms of Copenhagen, Capital city of Denmark. Handmade copy closely resembling the 1661 letter of priviliges issued by King Frederick III. The copy was reprinted in 1894.
gallery.dateCreated: 1661, copied by hand by an unknown artist no later than 1894
categories: Greater coats of arms of Copenhagen
